description: episode 5 of ‘back to the classics’ calls for these fudge crinkle-top brown butter brownies because is there anythinggg better?? i don’t think so 😌 they’re rich, dense, and decadent with a soft, fudgy center and that perfect shiny crinkle top that makes a brownie truly irresistible 🍫 there’s also a hint of espresso mixed in — not enough to taste like coffee, but just enough to enhance and deepen the chocolate in the best way (trust me)! finished with a sprinkle of flaky sea salt, these brownies strike that perfect balance of sweet, rich, and slightly salty ✨ the full recipe is up on my blog at wellmadebykiley.com 🤎 enjoy!! #brownbutterbrownies #thebestbrownierecipe #fudgybrownies #chocolate #Dessert
transcript: We're going to bloom our cocoa powder and espresso powder. We are going to whisk, whisk, whisk this. I want to make sure that the sugar is fully dissolved. That's going to give you the really nice crinkly top. It should be like a really pale yellow, nice and frothy. And the sugar should be dissolved. Our chocolate mixture is cooled. We are going to add all of it. This is the prettiest part.
